text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Less than one month remains until<n>the Arima Kinen.
There's just one<n>problem...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide's running is stiff.<n>Everything about
her just seems<n>rigid. Now that the showdown is
almost here, it seems she's feeling<n>the pressure.
choice_data_list: Let's take a couple deep breaths to relax.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Okay.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Breathe in. Breathe out.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We're almost out of track time, and<n>the other
Umamusume are starting to<n>wrap things up. I need
to figure<n>something out fast...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: BREATHE IIIN!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And BREATHE OOOUT!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Come on, Hayahide! Do it with me!<n>IIIN!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... There's a fine line betweenbeing helpful and obnoxious, dummy.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Lift your head up, Hayahide.<n>Slouching like that
makes it look<n>bigger than usual.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?! My head's perfectly—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
There, your back just straightened<n>out. That should
make it easier for<n>you to breathe.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whatever. I didn't come here for<n>thanks. I only said
it because she's<n>hogging the track, and
everyone's<n>waiting.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Your time slot's almost over, and you<n>two are just
standing around like you<n>own the place.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on, Taishin! You're the one<n>who was all,
"Oh no, let's go see<n>what's wrong with Hayahide!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Shut up. I never said that...
choice_data_list: You're lucky to have such good friends.
You're lucky to have such good friends.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I really am. They're almost too good<n>for me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't we all go for one<n>more lap and end
today's training<n>with a bang?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Seriously?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Come on you guys! Let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Deeerbyyy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I wonder if she noticed the Derby's<n>over already...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be Ticket if she didn't<n>shout random
things all the time.<n>Besides, her energy always
cheers<n>me up.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm so grateful to have met you two.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, okay, that's very sweet and<n>everything.
Anyway...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You gonna run or what?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, count me in!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Forgetting all about their agreement to<n>run just one
lap, the three friends<n>keep going until time runs out.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
All the tension seems to melt from<n>Biwa
Hayahide's shoulders, and her<n>form looks great
once more.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: HA-YA-HI-DE!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please... We're using names as a<n>running chant
now?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: TIII-CKET! TAAAI-SHIN!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Hey, it's not bad! Besides, the<n>act of
vocalizing has a demonstrable<n>effect on gross
motor movements.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But more than that, shouting your<n>names really
motivates me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me you're losing your mind<n>too...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So? Are we gonna catch up to the<n>wild child or
what?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide, Winning Ticket, and<n>Narita Taishin
keep racing around the<n>track without a care in the
world.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems her friends' shouts of<n>encouragement
have a positive effect<n>on Hayahide, who can't stop
grinning.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Did I do that right? I could've sworn<n>that was the
right time to yell...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! Hahaha! Nah, that was perfect.<n>Come on, let's
run.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: See ya!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hey! No fair, Taishiiin!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Mind if I go too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Go for it! Get that W!
Go for it! Get that W!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Roger!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide chases after Winning<n>Ticket and
Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She ends up crossing the finish line<n>first despite
their head start.
